name: dogfood-visual-regression
description: Dogfood app (v1.16-4) — Chromatic-style visual regression flow with baseline seed + pixel diff + accept / reject review workflow. 10 UI scenes (5 primitives × light + dark) run through a mock adapter (@kiwa-lab/component createChromaticVisualMock + hashMarkup) and a skipped real adapter (chromatic-cli sim, env-gated on CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN). Each scene is asserted on 4 axes — seed / capture / diff-on-intent-change / accept-restores-baseline — with a bonus reject axis. Fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate + latency samples from perf-harness for the 3-layer perf report.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/component @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
